# Phase B Base Config Template
# Derived from exp026 (step-independent GRPO, verified working)
# Fields marked [PHASE_B_TUNE] are candidates for sweep / manual adjustment

defaults:
  - base

hydra:
  searchpath:
    - pkg://verl.trainer.config

# [PHASE_B_TUNE] Update to exp026 best checkpoint after MVP passes
model_path: /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/qwen3_exp021_ragen_sft_v4

system:
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: "0,1"

micro_batch_size_per_gpu: 1
ppo_mini_batch_size: 32

trainer:
  project_name: cost-verify-agent-rl
  # [PHASE_B_TUNE] Update experiment name per run
  experiment_name: phase-b-biavr-sweep
  total_training_steps: 150
  n_gpus_per_node: 2
  val_before_train: True
  test_freq: 5
  save_freq: 25
  # [PHASE_B_TUNE] Update checkpoint dir per run
  local_log_dir: "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/phase_b/"
  default_local_dir: "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/phase_b/"
  logger: ['console', 'wandb']  # wandb enabled (was console-only in some prior exps)
  max_actor_ckpt_to_keep: 3
  resume_mode: "disable"

actor_rollout_ref:
  model:
    override_config:
      attn_implementation: sdpa
  actor:
    use_ref: True
    use_torch_compile: False
    use_kl_loss: True
    # [PHASE_B_TUNE] sweep range: [0.005, 0.01, 0.02]
    kl_loss_coef: 0.01
    kl_loss_type: low_var_kl
    clip_ratio_low: 0.2
    clip_ratio_high: 0.28
    loss_agg_mode: "seq-mean-token-mean"
